normalization.title: The Best Agent Instructions Aren't Instructions
normalization.overview: Lauren Tan's case for codebases that constrain mistakes, verify behavior, and earn the right to automate.
normalization.whyItMatters: A high pull-request rate and low revert rate do not prove quality; enforceable boundaries and runtime evidence matter.
normalization.ghostMeshTakeaway: Improve APIs, encode repeated corrections in deterministic checks, and examine user-visible behavior before expanding autonomous merges.

archiveCall.label: Constrain mistakes, then verify behavior
archiveCall.text: Move recurring corrections into code and tests; judge outcomes rather than PR counts.

normalization.falsification: Compare comparable accepted outcomes, escaped defects, rework, user impact and review burden before treating low reverts as quality.
normalization.freshness: Speaker-reported operating data requires independent, scoped verification.
